sentences.text: Sirajuddin And 12 Others vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 6

Bench: Sudhir Agarwal, Rajeev Misra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 34
Case :- Writ - C No. - 8446 of 2020
Petitioner :- Sirajuddin And 12 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Afjal Ahmad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
1. Heard Sri Afjal Ahmad, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for State.

2. It is stated that petitioner has applied for license under Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standard (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulation, 2011, on 01.06.2017 but no decision has been taken by the competent authority till date.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulation, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned Standing Counsel states that in case application of petitioner for license is pending,
appropriate decision shall be taken expeditiously.
4. Considering the facts and circumstances of case, this petition stands disposed of, directing respondent-4 Food Safety Officer, Ballia to take a decision on the pending application of petitioner,
expeditiously.

In any case, decision shall be taken within two months from the date of production of Sirajuddin And 12 Others vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 6 March, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83525646/
